Title: Public preview: Login and TDE-enabled database migrations with Azure Database Migration Service

Body.Content:
The new capability in the Azure SQL Migration extension makes your post-database migration experience more seamless. Now you can receive assistance with the migration of instance-level objects such as SQL and Windows logins, permissions, server roles, and updated user mapping of previously migrated databases.

Perform migrations of TDE-enabled databases with an easy-to-use wizard that automates the process of backing up, copying, and reconfiguring database encryption keys for Azure SQL Managed Instance targets.

Learn more about login migrations. 

Learn more about TDE-enabled database migrations.
